title: Senior Data Analyst, Clinical Operations
job_description:
Role: Senior Data Analyst, Clinical Operations

Company: Atlas Oncology Partners

Location: Remote, with preference for Nashville or Boston

Travel: 10%

Position Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $90,000-$110,000 base, 10-15% bonus

About Us

Atlas is built for oncologists by oncologists. We provide practices with the staff, contracts, and toolkit they need to deliver truly whole person care to their cancer patients. Our value-based approach to care delivery aligns incentives, offering patients better outcomes, payors guaranteed reduction in medical expense, and provider partners greater financial independence.

Role Overview

Atlas has invested in a robust operations data infrastructure, and we're looking for someone who can build on that foundation to accelerate automation and speed-to-insight across our analytics workflows. The Senior Data Analyst, Clinical Operations will be a strategic analytics partner to clinical operations leadership, bringing together data from multiple platforms — including call center data, outcomes reporting, and our integrated Snowflake data warehouse that houses EMR data— to understand productivity and performance drivers across care teams. This role owns the full lifecycle of operational reporting: pulling and reconciling data across sources, reviewing it for accuracy and consistency, building and maintaining dashboards, and generating insights that practice administrators and leadership can act on.

Key Responsibilities

Data Integration & Quality

Pull, combine, and reconcile data from multiple platforms into unified analyses
Scope includes data supporting engagement, clinical programs, clinical documentation, and care team access/productivity
QC data across sources to identify inconsistencies, gaps, or errors, and resolve or escalate data integrity issues as needed
Maintain documentation of data sources, definitions, and report logic to ensure consistency across analyses

Reporting & Dashboards

Build and maintain datasets to analyze care team productivity, call volumes/handling, and EHR-based workflow data across practice-partner sites
Design, build, and maintain recurring dashboards and reports that track key operational metrics over time

Insights & Analysis

Identify drivers of performance variation across teams, sites, and roles
Generate clear, actionable insights from complex, multi-source datasets and present them to both technical and non-technical audiences, including clinic-level operators and senior leadership

Stakeholder Partnership

Gather requirements from clinical operations leadership and translate them into specific, actionable analyses

Automation & Process Improvement

To address all of the above responsibilities efficiently, individual should leverage modern tools and techniques (e.g., Excel Power Query, SQL, Claude)
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate recurring analyses and scale reporting capacity across the organization

Reporting: This role will report to the VP of Clinical Operations

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, Economics, or related) or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of experience in healthcare data analysis, with strong SQL proficiency and advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling)
Experience working with EHR-sourced operational data and call center/IVR data in a healthcare or practice-operations setting
Demonstrated ability to combine and QC data from multiple systems and build reliable, maintainable dashboards
Ability to understand organizational goals and priorities and translate them into meaningful, trackable metrics
Experience automating data and reporting processes using tools such as Power Query, SQL, and generative AI
Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude or Copilot to support day-to-day analytical work
Strong communication skills and comfort translating complex data into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with oncology or specialty care practice operations
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience in a high growth startup
Experience in outpatient value-based care primary care

Some of the benefits of our comprehensive benefits package includes:

Health, Dental, Vision insurance
Competitive pay
Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

You will collaborate with like-minded health care professionals who, like you, understand the importance and value of Atlas’ high-quality, value-based care model.

Atlas is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We take affirmative action to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristics.

Compensation Range: $90K - $110K
